Name: NITV - SH's Wild Animals In The Valley
Author: plurffle
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/2K9PcNV.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿

Soooo... Remember my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9063][b]SH's Wild Animals[/b][/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21231][b]SH's Wild Animals Lite[/b][/url] mods?[/center]
No? If you're new here- Hi!﻿ My name's [b][color=#b4a7d6]plurffle[/color][/b]/[b][color=#b4a7d6]SmolHooman[/color][/b] (which was my first username before I started making more mods) and I've been making mostly animal-themed mods for Stardew Valley since the start of my modding hobby for this exact game (crazy to think that my mod was first uploaded back in 2021!). My original little Wild Animals series had a very simple premise in mind: add some wild animals to the world of Stardew Valley, [i]mainly[/i] as dynamic ambience that changed with the time and date and how you played the game.

So why the new upload here called "[color=#e69138][b]SH's Wild Animals In The Valley[/b][/color]"? A redux for the original mod of course ([i]creative name I know[/i])!

My original Wild Animals mods were... A bit performance heavy (especially for low-end computers or highly-modded playthroughs), and the animals didn't really do much else other than make the valley appear more full. Not super mod-expansion-compatible either. But [b]this [/b]version is quite different!

[center]Are [b]you[/b] the type to turn animal captivity into a money-making opportunity?
Well. I won't stop you because I'm not your parent. [i]But[/i] I will say do not replicate such actions in real life! Seriously![/center]

[left][img]https://imgur.com/pZDKvzl.png[/img][/left]
Get ready to have the ability to catch all the animals available for whatever reason you may want! Catch these wild critters to complete the encyclopedia, gain vanilla resources, sell for profit, or even keep certain types in terrariums in your very own home! Or simply enjoy the added ambience while you stroll around doing your daily farmer/fighter/fisher/forager/miner/serial romancer duties. More ambience has always been my goal.

So as of version 1.0.0, we will be seeing the common valley critters such as squirrels, frogs, rats, crabs, seagulls, etc, as well as some others forest animals from my main mod roaming all around you and your fellow Pelican Town townsfolk. All of them are catchable (though some- specifically the larger animals- cannot be placed in terrariums). [b]Be careful by the way. Some animals aren't too fond of you [/b](and I mean it, proceed with caution if you're low on health out there)[b]![/b]

[b]Q: Why not update the original Custom Companions version instead of making this new Nature In The Valley version?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]Honestly, that [i]was[/i] the original plan, but... Wild Animals using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions framework[/url] is a different experience compared to this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature In The Valley[/url] version. I like how the original Wild Animals works, and implementing the changes from this mod here to the original will result in me [i]overriding[/i] certain features that I genuinely want to preserve.

[b]Q: What is the difference between this mod version (Nature In The Valley) vs the Custom Companions version?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]The Custom Companions version (the original version of this mod) is more of a purely cosmetic type of mod (with a lot more detail to their animations), while the Nature In The Valley version here is much more interactive. Plus, [u]this version has better performance [i]and[/i] better mod compatibilities[/u]!

[b]Q: Can I use both the original mod versions (Custom Companions version) with this mod?[/b]
[b]A: [/b]You still can, yes!﻿﻿ But combining both the original with this version could be confusing with figuring out which animals can and cannot be caught. However, if you're simply in it for the variety and ambience, you can definitely use both versions of my mods.

[b]Q: Is this mod compatible with [insert mod name]?[/b]
[b]A: [/b][u][i]Yes[/i], the answer is a highly likely a [i]yes[/i][/u]. All the critters should be able to load in their appropriate maps regardless if vanilla maps have been insanely altered by certain mods. These animals should also be able to automatically load in newly added maps from other mods as long as it's deemed appropriate for them.


[left][img]https://imgur.com/Sc1YLe8.png[/img][/left]
Please﻿ feel free to share feedback over at the Comments section [i]and[/i] report bugs either at the Comments section or Bugs section!

I've been pretty much doing all my mods on my own and I have a bit of a hard time keep track of things. Suggestions? Go on ahead and share them too! Sometimes I don't have a response, but that doesn't mean I haven't read them (I just don't know how to form words sometimes lol)! And- Sometimes I genuinely forget or got distracted... Feel free to remind me of the important things!

And seriously, I'm not good at figuring out how to balance things perfectly- So feedback and suggestions are definitely helpful!



I have a Ko-fi btw! If you like my works, then feel free to [url=https://ko-fi.com/smolhooman_plurffle]buy me a coffee[/url]﻿~! I'll greatly appreciate the support! <3 However, my mods will always stay free for the public!
